candidates.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
verified_facts: The DTM archive contains survey-specific raster elevation data at 25cm, 50cm, 1m or 2m resolution depending on the project.
Surface objects are removed to create a terrain model; data is in metres, aligned to OS Grid and referenced to Ordnance Datum Newlyn with stated vertical accuracy of plus/minus 15cm RMSE.
semantic_limits: A DTM tile is usable as terrain evidence only with the correct survey date, resolution, transformation/geoid lineage and parcel-pixel relationship; catalogue existence alone is insufficient.

candidates.name: LIDAR DSM Time Stamped Tiles
verified_facts: The DSM archive contains survey-specific elevation rasters and includes heights of objects such as buildings, vegetation and vehicles as well as terrain.
The data is aligned to OS Grid, referenced to Ordnance Datum Newlyn and carries the same stated vertical accuracy contract.
semantic_limits: DSM values cannot be substituted for bare-earth terrain when parcel height difference requires ground elevation; object heights must remain distinguishable from DTM ground surface.
